# Spaced Repetition for Developers

Spaced repetition schedules reviews at growing intervals so that a fact is
reviewed just before it would be forgotten. Developers can apply it to API
signatures, command-line flags and design patterns.

## Three practical rules

1. Write one atomic question per card.
2. Review daily, in short sessions of ten minutes.
3. Delete cards you no longer need instead of letting them pile up.

## Where it breaks down

Spaced repetition works poorly for knowledge that changes fast, such as
framework versions. Pair it with notes that link back to the primary source.
